title: The Portland, Why HCA 2026 - Selects (Gaps Closed)

shots.description: Aerial drone shot over central London looking north across Marylebone Road towards the curved terraces of Park Crescent and the trees of Park Square, with traffic moving through the junction below. The area is the Marylebone and Great Portland Street neighbourhood around The Portland Hospital, though the hospital building is not clearly identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot over Marylebone Road in central London, showing the curved white terrace of Park Crescent, its gardens, the round Great Portland Street station building and traffic moving through the junction. The camera moves slowly over the rooftops of Marylebone and Fitzrovia, the area around The Portland Hospital, though the hospital is not clearly identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot over central London looking across Marylebone Road and Park Crescent towards Marylebone and the West End, the area around The Portland Hospital. Traffic moves along Marylebone Road past Great Portland Street station and the Holy Trinity church tower.

Aerial drone shot over central London looking north across Marylebone Road towards a curved white terrace and the trees of Regent's Park, with traffic moving along the roads below. The hospital building itself is not identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot moving over central London rooftops towards the curved terrace of Park Crescent and the round roof of Great Portland Street station, the Marylebone area around The Portland Hospital. Streets with light traffic and bare winter trees are visible below.

Aerial drone shot moving over central London streets near the area of The Portland Hospital, showing a curved white terrace beside a tree-filled garden, a white office block on a corner and red-brick mansion buildings, with light traffic on the roads below. No hospital signage is legible in frame.

Aerial drone shot moving forward over a central London street junction, with mid-rise office and mansion blocks and traffic on the roads below. No hospital building or signage is identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over central London streets on an overcast day, with traffic on a long road, office and mansion blocks, and a round rooftop building in the foreground. No hospital building or signage is identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot over central London streets near Great Portland Street. The camera rises and tilts up from a road junction to reveal the rooftops of Marylebone, a curved white terrace and the trees of Regent's Park.

Drone shot over central London looking north across Marylebone Road towards the curved terrace of Park Crescent and the trees of Regent's Park, with red buses and traffic moving through the junction. Shows the neighbourhood around The Portland Hospital, though the hospital building is not clearly identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot over central London on an overcast day, moving across a busy road junction with red double-decker buses, a round domed building and tree-lined squares, in what appears to be the Great Portland Street and Park Crescent area near The Portland Hospital. The camera turns slowly to reveal Marylebone rooftops and a church spire.

Aerial drone shot over central London's Marylebone area, circling above what appears to be All Souls Church at Langham Place, with Portland Place leading north towards the white curved terraces of Park Crescent. Traffic moves along the streets below on an overcast day, establishing the neighbourhood around The Portland Hospital.

Aerial drone shot that starts looking down on a junction with a domed building and red buses, then tilts up to show central London rooftops and the City skyline under an overcast sky. Works as an establishing shot for the area around The Portland Hospital.

High-angle view over central London rooftops on an overcast day, with red buses and traffic moving through a junction below and the city skyline in the distance. Establishing shot of the city around the hospital.

Aerial drone view over central London rooftops and streets on an overcast day, with red double-decker buses and traffic moving around a junction with a round domed building and the City skyline on the horizon. The drone moves slowly forward over the area.
Aerial drone shot moving slowly over central London streets and rooftops near the hospital, with traffic and red buses below and the City skyline on the horizon under an overcast sky.

Drone shot over central London that starts on a wide view of the rooftops and tilts down to a busy street with cars, vans and a red bus passing between office buildings and a white stone building with a clock face. The hospital is not identifiable in the shot.

Aerial drone shot over a quiet central London street lined with tall pale stone buildings, including one with a clock and cupola, as a red van and a few cars drive along the road. No hospital signage is visible.
Aerial drone shot moving over rooftops along a quiet central London street lined with pale stone and brick office buildings, with a domed corner tower and a few pedestrians below.

High aerial view over a central London street junction lined with white office blocks and red-brick buildings under an overcast sky, with pedestrians and a few vehicles moving through the crossing below. Works as a London location establishing shot; no hospital is identifiable in frame.
Aerial drone shot moving over a central London street toward a white stone building with a domed clock tower, flanked by office blocks. A few cars travel along the road below.

Drone shot rises from street level between office and residential buildings in central London to reveal the wider area, including a busy road junction with a round station building and red buses, with park trees in the distance. The area appears to be around Great Portland Street and Marylebone Road, near The Portland Hospital, though the hospital building itself is not clearly identifiable.

Aerial drone shot at dusk over a central London junction with traffic, buses and a round domed building, with curved white terraces and park trees behind, near Great Portland Street and Regent's Park. The camera moves slowly over the area.

Aerial drone shot over the Marylebone Road junction at Great Portland Street, showing the round station building, the curved Park Crescent terrace and gardens, and traffic and buses moving through the crossing at dusk. A location establisher for the area around The Portland Hospital; the hospital itself is not clearly identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot over a busy central London junction, likely around Great Portland Street station with the curved Park Crescent terrace and trees behind, as red buses and traffic move along the roads. It works as a location establisher for The Portland Hospital's neighbourhood. The hospital building itself is not identifiable.

Drone shot moving over central London at the Marylebone Road junction, showing the round Great Portland Street station building, the curved terraces of Park Crescent and the trees of Regent's Park beyond, with buses and traffic below. This is the neighbourhood around The Portland Hospital, but the hospital is not clearly identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot over Great Portland Street station, Park Crescent and Marylebone Road in central London, with traffic moving through the junction and Regent's Park trees behind. This is the neighbourhood around The Portland Hospital. The hospital is not clearly identifiable in frame.

Aerial drone shot moving across a central London junction, showing a circular domed building, white office blocks and curved terraces with trees behind. This appears to be the area near Park Crescent and Regent's Park around The Portland Hospital; traffic, including a red double-decker bus, moves along the roads below.

Aerial drone shot moving over central London toward Park Crescent and Regent's Park, with Great Portland Street station's round building and traffic on Marylebone Road below. It establishes the Marylebone and Fitzrovia area around The Portland Hospital, though no hospital signage is visible.
Drone shot of The Portland Hospital building on a London street corner, with its name sign above the ground-floor entrance, as cars drive past and a few pedestrians walk on the pavement.
Aerial drone shot of The Portland Hospital building on a London street corner, with a white lorry turning through the junction and pedestrians crossing on an overcast day.
Aerial drone shot of The Portland Hospital building on a street corner, with cars driving through the junction and pedestrians walking on the pavements below.

Aerial drone shot over central London rooftops on an overcast day, drifting slowly over a church tower and a busy junction with red double-decker buses and traffic, with the city skyline in the distance.

Drone shot over central London on an overcast day, looking north-east across what appears to be the Marylebone Road and Great Portland Street junction near The Portland Hospital, with traffic, a red bus and the city skyline beyond. The camera drifts slowly over the rooftops and the domed round building at the junction.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over a central London street on an overcast day, with office and mansion blocks lining the road, light traffic and a few pedestrians below, and the city skyline in the distance.

Camera tilts down from linear ceiling lights to a granite wall at The Portland Hospital entrance, revealing the HCA Healthcare UK logo and The Portland Hospital name sign with the 209 Great Portland Street address.

shots.description: Camera moves through the entrance lobby of The Portland Hospital, past a plant and under linear ceiling lights, ending on the HCA Healthcare UK and The Portland Hospital sign on a granite wall with the address 209 Great Portland Street.

shots.description: Exterior of The Portland Hospital entrance on a London street, showing the HCA-branded 'The Portland Hospital' sign beside the covered entrance with columns and topiary planters. The camera moves smoothly toward the sign past a lamp post in the foreground.

Low-angle exterior shot moving along the front of The Portland Hospital, with the hospital name in raised letters above the ground-floor windows. The sky is overcast, there are bare winter trees, and the windows reflect the buildings across the street.

Low-angle exterior of The Portland Hospital showing the 'The Portland' lettering above the ground-floor windows. The camera moves along the facade and through the entrance to the reception desk with the HCA Healthcare UK sign and a receptionist at work.

shots.description: The camera moves out from behind a lift wall to reveal the reception desk at The Portland Hospital, where a receptionist sits at a computer in front of HCA Healthcare UK and Portland Hospital signage. The lobby includes lifts, doors and ring pendant lights.

shots.description: A male receptionist in a suit sits at the main reception desk of The Portland Hospital, with the HCA Healthcare UK logo on the wall behind him. The camera pushes in as he looks up, smiles and gestures with an outstretched arm as if welcoming or directing someone.

shots.description: The camera moves from a shelf of potted blue hydrangeas into a paediatric corridor with a children's wall mural, where a nurse in a maroon uniform opens a door and looks back smiling. Behind her is a treatment room lit in blue with a hospital bed.
A paediatric ultrasound room with sea-life wall murals, then a children's corridor lined with wall-mounted activity toys and play panels as a staff member walks past the camera.

Low-angle tracking shot following a staff member in a light tunic and dark trousers as she walks down a paediatric corridor lined with children's activity wall panels and waiting chairs, towards a play area.

Low-angle shot following a staff member down a children's hospital corridor decorated with an under-the-sea mural, as a red children's ride-on electric toy car drives along the corridor towards the camera.

A staff member wearing a name badge stands at a doorway and gestures into a children's treatment room. The camera moves past her into the room to show ocean and panda wall murals, sky-print ceiling panels, a treatment bed and a drip stand.
Two staff members in maroon uniforms sit at computer workstations reviewing scans, and one points to an axial brain MRI image on a monitor.
Camera pans across a children's wall mural showing cartoon panda pirates on a ship and a palm-tree island, in a paediatric area at The Portland Hospital.

A toddler girl with a hair clip plays with a wall-mounted shape puzzle board, turning coloured wooden discs with star, heart and other shapes. The camera moves around her as she reaches up to the board in a children's play area.
A toddler girl with a hair clip plays with colourful wooden shapes on a wall-mounted activity panel in a children's area corridor at The Portland Hospital.

A toddler plays with wooden shapes on a sensory wall in a children's imaging room at The Portland Hospital, then a staff member crouches beside her as they look up at a colourful ocean-themed mural. Lead protective aprons hang on a rack in the background.

A staff member in a maroon tunic crouches beside a toddler in a corridor decorated with an underwater mural, then points at the sea creatures on the wall to engage the child. Protective lead aprons hang on hooks nearby, suggesting a children's imaging area.

A staff member in a burgundy uniform crouches to talk with a toddler in a paediatric X-ray room decorated with an ocean-themed wall mural, then prepares near the X-ray unit. Shows a child being put at ease before an imaging appointment.
A radiographer in a maroon uniform smiles and talks with a toddler girl in an X-ray room, then moves across the room as the camera follows. A friendly paediatric moment ahead of a child's X-ray.
A staff member in a maroon uniform sits beside a toddler in a white lace dress in an X-ray room. The child smiles and looks up while the staff member talks and looks towards someone off camera.

A staff member in a maroon tunic sits with a toddler on the table in an X-ray room, smiling and playing with her before an examination. The child holds up a small box while the staff member stands nearby, then sits beside her again.

A staff member in a maroon tunic sits beside a toddler in a hospital gown on a bed in an X-ray room and shows her picture cards to keep her engaged. The child smiles and reaches for the cards, with a soft toy beside her.

A toddler in a patient gown sits on an X-ray table and smiles as a staff member in a maroon tunic shows her picture cards to settle her before imaging. Paediatric X-ray room with the overhead tube and wall detector behind them.
A nurse sits beside a smiling toddler on an examination couch in a children's consulting room and shows the child something on a tablet or card. The child watches and smiles.

A radiographer in maroon scrubs smiles and positions a ceiling-mounted X-ray tube in an X-ray room, making playful faces toward a young child who is partly visible from behind at the start of the shot.
A radiographer positions a young child's hand on an X-ray detector, using a red laser guide and placing a lead marker beside the hand before a paediatric hand X-ray.
A radiographer positions a child's hand flat on an X-ray table, lining it up with the red laser guide before an image is taken. Close-up on the two hands, with the child's frilled sleeve visible.

A young child sits on a padded bench as an adult offers a basket of stickers and small toys. The shot moves to a nurse in burgundy scrubs laughing and smiling with the child during a paediatric visit.

A smiling toddler in a pink pinafore sits on a clinic table while a staff member in a maroon top gently places something on her finger, possibly a dressing or sensor, during a paediatric appointment at The Portland Hospital.

A toddler smiles and plays in a children's clinical room, followed by a painted underwater mural of fish and coral, then a nurse sitting on a hospital bed talking with a young child in a patient room at The Portland Hospital.

A staff member in a teal uniform sits on a hospital bed with a young girl in a printed gown, showing her something in her hands and chatting with her in a children's patient room. Shot from behind the bed rail, with the girl seen mostly from behind.

A staff member in a teal uniform uses a baby doll with a face mask and a toy panda to show a young girl in a hospital gown how a mask works, while the girl holds a mask to her own face. They sit on a hospital bed in a children's room at The Portland Hospital, with sensory bubble-tube lights behind.

A staff member in a teal uniform sits on a hospital bed with a young child in pyjamas, playing with a baby doll and a panda soft toy in a paediatric patient room. The child is seen from behind, and a sensory bubble tube light glows in the background.
kit: medical gas and wall outlet panel

shots.description: A staff member in a teal polo shirt uses a baby doll and a face mask to show a young child how a breathing mask is used, with a panda soft toy beside them. The child, seen from behind and out of focus in the foreground, holds the mask.

Camera tilts down from a ceiling lit with projected sensory lights to a nurse in scrubs talking with a young girl in floral pyjamas sitting on a hospital bed in a children's patient room. A bubble tube sensory light glows behind them.

A staff member in a teal uniform uses a baby doll to play with a young girl in a hospital gown sitting on a bed in a children's patient room, likely to explain care through play. A cuddly panda toy sits beside them and a sensory bubble tube light is in the background.

A staff member plays with a toddler in a paediatric sensory room with fibre optic light strands, reaching up to wind chimes together, then supporting the child as she sits on a red therapy ball and climbs onto a large blue ball.
kit: soft play mats and foam blocks

shots.description: A staff member in a green uniform sits with a young child in a paediatric sensory room, watching the child play in front of a light-up LED mirror. The child turns and smiles at their reflection while the staff member looks on.
A toddler explores textured sensory panels on a wall while a woman kneels beside her and watches, in a softly lit sensory play room.

A young boy walks on a treadmill holding the handrails in front of a mirror while a physiotherapist holding the treadmill control encourages him during a paediatric rehabilitation session. The camera moves in over her shoulder toward the boy.

A young boy walks on a treadmill holding its handrails while watching himself in a mirror, as a physiotherapist stands beside him holding a handheld controller during a paediatric rehabilitation session.

A boy walks on a low treadmill with handrails in front of a mirror while a staff member in a navy uniform controls the treadmill from a handheld device. A paediatric gait or physiotherapy rehabilitation session at The Portland Hospital.

A physiotherapist uses a handheld controller to run a low treadmill while a young boy walks on it holding the handrails, during a paediatric rehabilitation session in a therapy room at The Portland Hospital.

A young boy in a white T-shirt grips the handlebar of a walking frame and steps forward during a paediatric physiotherapy session in a bright room with a ceiling hoist track and wall-mounted medical gas outlets.

A physiotherapist in a navy uniform places her hands on a boy's lower back as he sits on a red treatment couch, facing an underwater-themed wall mural, during what appears to be a posture assessment at The Portland Hospital.

A physiotherapist and a young child lift a red exercise ball overhead together during a therapy session in a rehab room with a blue wall mural. The camera moves from the hands on the ball to the therapist seen from behind, with the child across from her.
A physiotherapist in a navy uniform guides a young boy through arm exercises with a red exercise ball, lifting it overhead in front of an ocean-themed mural with turtles at The Portland Hospital.

A physiotherapist works with a young boy as he lifts a red exercise ball above his head against a sea-themed mural wall, supporting him at the back. The shot opens on hands on the ball and pulls back to show the paediatric therapy session.

Low-angle camera move inside and around an empty EOS low-dose X-ray imaging cabin, ending with a wide view of the unit showing its standing platform and EOS branding in an imaging room at The Portland Hospital.

A radiographer works at a computer in the imaging control room, with the EOS low-dose X-ray imaging system visible in the scan room beyond. She uses the mouse and then reaches across the desk to the second workstation.
A nurse in maroon scrubs works at a computer workstation, then the camera moves across the desk to a hand pressing a button on a small desk device beside the monitors and keyboard.
A radiographer guides a young boy in a hospital gown into position against an upright X-ray detector, then reaches up to adjust the equipment as he stands waiting.

A staff member in a maroon uniform positions a young boy in a hospital gown against an upright imaging stand and helps him hold an overhead handle for a scan. This appears to be a paediatric X-ray setup.
A young boy in a hospital gown stands at an upright X-ray detector holding the overhead handles while a radiographer in a maroon tunic adjusts and positions the X-ray equipment for his scan.

A radiographer in a maroon tunic positions a young boy in a hospital gown against an upright X-ray detector, with the boy holding the overhead handle. She lines up the positioning lasers on the X-ray table edge before stepping back.

A boy in a hospital gown steps into an upright X-ray unit at The Portland Hospital and holds the overhead handle bar while green and red positioning lasers line up on him. The camera pulls back to show him standing still for the scan.

A radiographer positions a young boy in a hospital gown inside an upright X-ray imaging system as he holds the overhead handles. The camera moves from a side view to a low angle looking up at the boy while she checks his position.
kit: upright imaging cabin with overhead hand grips

shots.description: An EOS low-dose X-ray imaging system stands in an empty imaging room at The Portland Hospital, with the camera moving slowly along the side of the machine past the EOS logo.

Camera moves through an empty private patient room at The Portland Hospital, passing a made hospital bed with an overbed table holding a black folder, beside a window with curtains, then looks back through the doorway toward the room and wash basin.

A nurse in a red uniform stands at the door of an empty private patient room, smiles at the camera, then opens the door and looks back as she steps inside. The room has a made hospital bed by a large curtained window.
kit: wall-mounted medical gas and power panel

shots.description: A camera moves through a doorway into the lounge area of a private suite, showing blue-grey armchairs, a grey leather sofa, a coffee table with tissues and a plate of treats, and a sideboard with a coffee machine and flowers by a curtained window.

A welcome gift bag with a panda soft toy, rolled items and a bottle of champagne sits on a desk in a patient room at The Portland Hospital, next to a storage box, a mirror and bottles of water on a tray. The hospital bed is reflected in the mirror as the camera moves slowly along the desk.

Camera moves across a private patient room at The Portland Hospital, past a desk with an open overnight bag holding a panda soft toy, to a cabinet with a coffee machine, flowers and a lamp beside an armchair and window.

Interior of a patient room at The Portland Hospital, showing a sideboard with a lamp, a vase of flowers, a coffee machine and cups, plus a fruit platter on a table. The camera moves from the sideboard to the fruit platter and back towards the sideboard.

A staff member in a red uniform walks through a doorway into an empty private patient room. The camera follows in to show a made bed, an overbed table with a folder, a bedside cabinet with a lamp, and a curtained window.

Camera moves right past a floor lamp, a vase of flowers and a coffee machine with cups into a private patient room at The Portland Hospital. The room has a made hospital bed, an overbed table with a folder on it and a lit bedside lamp.
kit: medical gas and power wall outlets

shots.description: A hospital staff member in a black waistcoat pushes a meal trolley with a silver cloche along a corridor at The Portland Hospital, walking towards the camera and smiling. The camera moves backwards ahead of her as she passes patient room doors.

Camera pulls back from a window looking out over the London skyline and rooftops on a sunny day, revealing a quiet hospital corridor with a chair and a red wall-mounted bag. The footage is ungraded log.

Low-angle view of glass wall signs on a maternity floor corridor reading 'Welcome to the 7th Floor', naming the midwife in charge today, and marking the entrance to 'Delivery 2', with a wall clock visible through a doorway. The camera drifts sideways across the signage.
shots.text_on_screen: Welcome to the 7th Floor; The Midwife in charge today is: Aimma Ali; Delivery 2

shots.description: Four theatre staff in scrubs and HCA scrub caps stand around an operating table in a theatre, looking at a tablet held by one colleague and chatting and smiling together.

Four clinical staff in navy scrubs and HCA scrub caps stand in a cath lab, with a Siemens C-arm overhead, reviewing information on a tablet in a green protective case. One staff member holds the tablet and talks it through while the others watch and listen.

Staff in navy scrubs and theatre caps stand around a Siemens Artis C-arm in an interventional suite at The Portland Hospital, looking at a tablet in a green protective case while a colleague explains. The camera tracks right past the team and ends on the Artis unit with one staff member in frame.
A senior clinician holds up a tablet and briefs a group of colleagues in scrubs and theatre caps around the procedure table in a cath lab, with the C-arm overhead.

Camera moves through operating theatre doors, past a theatre with staff in scrubs and a trolley, into an adjoining lab where a staff member in scrubs and a surgical cap works at a microscope, possibly in an embryology lab.

Two embryologists in blue scrubs and surgical caps work at a microscope inside an IVF lab workstation at The Portland Hospital. The camera pulls back from a close view of one looking through the microscope to show the second colleague standing beside her.
A lab worker in blue scrubs uses a pipette to handle a culture dish at a microscope workstation in a fertility or embryology lab, with a colleague working in the background.

Embryologists work in the fertility lab: one looks through a microscope, a staff member lifts the lid of a liquid nitrogen cryostorage tank as vapour rises, and another uses a Nikon micromanipulation microscope with a monitor alongside.

An embryologist in scrubs and a hair cap looks through a Nikon inverted microscope with micromanipulators in an IVF lab, and the shot moves across to a second embryologist working at a stereo microscope inside a lab workstation.
An embryologist in a surgical cap and scrubs looks through the eyepieces of a Nikon microscope in a fertility lab, with a label that appears to read ICSI on the microscope.

An embryologist in scrubs and a hair cap looks through a Nikon inverted microscope and adjusts the micromanipulator controls, while a monitor beside her shows a fine pipette in the dish. This appears to be a fertility lab procedure such as ICSI.

Two embryologists in blue scrubs and hair caps work at inverted microscopes with micromanipulation rigs in a fertility lab. The camera moves past the nearer embryologist towards her colleague, who is looking through the eyepieces while a monitor shows the magnified view.

An embryology lab monitor shows a magnified embryo held by a holding pipette while a fine micropipette approaches it, with the micromanipulator microscope in the foreground. This shows an IVF procedure such as embryo biopsy or ICSI under way.

An embryology lab where an egg is held by a pipette and injected with a fine needle during ICSI, shown live on a monitor beside the inverted microscope and micromanipulator controls. The camera moves between the microscope rig and the monitor view of the egg.

An embryologist in a scrub cap looks through a Nikon microscope at an ICSI workstation in a fertility lab. The camera moves across to a monitor showing an egg held by a pipette during intracytoplasmic sperm injection.

A sonographer in a burgundy uniform sits at an ultrasound machine, working the controls and watching the screen as a fetal ultrasound image appears. Two computer monitors on a desk are visible in the background of the dimly lit scanning room.

A sonographer in a burgundy uniform sits at an ultrasound machine and works the controls while a foetal pregnancy scan shows on the overhead monitor. Desktop computers and framed pictures are visible in the background of the scan room.

A sonographer in a maroon uniform sits at an ultrasound machine, smiling and talking to someone off camera, while a pregnancy ultrasound scan showing a baby is projected onto the wall of the scan room at The Portland Hospital.
A sonographer in a burgundy uniform sits in an ultrasound scan room and speaks to camera in an interview, with an ultrasound image projected on the wall behind her and computer monitors on a desk.
A sonographer in a burgundy uniform works at an ultrasound machine console in a dimly lit scanning room, using the keyboard and controls and looking up at the screen as she speaks.

A sonographer in a maroon uniform points to a fetal ultrasound image projected on the wall while talking to someone off camera, then uses the ultrasound machine's control panel. The shot is filmed through a blurred foreground in a dim scan room.

A nurse in a maroon uniform stands in front of a projected fetal ultrasound image, then the camera moves past a wall to a receptionist working at a computer on the front desk beneath an HCA Healthcare UK sign.

A receptionist works at a computer behind the reception desk, then looks up and smiles at the camera, with the HCA Healthcare UK logo on the wall behind her. The camera moves past the desk and ends in a motion-blurred pan across a white wall.

A receptionist works at the front desk of The Portland Outpatient Centre, typing at a computer and smiling beneath HCA Healthcare UK signage. The camera pulls back through a wooden doorway, leaving the reception area.
shots.text_on_screen: HCA Healthcare UK; The Portland Outpatient (partially obscured)

shots.description: Camera moves sideways past 'The Portland Hospital Outpatients' lettering on glass in front of wooden slat panelling, revealing the HCA Healthcare UK logo on a white wall with a curved illuminated feature and a plant in the outpatient reception area.
shots.text_on_screen: The Portland Hospital Outpatients; HCA Healthcare UK

shots.description: The HCA Healthcare UK logo on a backlit curved reception wall at The Portland Hospital, with the camera moving across to purple orchids and green plants in the foreground as focus shifts from the logo to the flowers.

Empty interior hallway with a dark wooden staircase and banisters, a tall window, and a corridor leading to a wooden panelled door. The camera moves through the space, showing the stairwell from different angles.
